name: cctv-dashboard
description: A Vietnamese university thesis system for multi-camera urban traffic monitoring, featuring real-time vehicle detection (YOLO11), cross-camera re-identification (OSNet/VeRi-776), ByteTrack multi-object tracking, and GRU-based trajectory/goal prediction, served via a FastAPI backend and a React/Vite dashboard. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
